name: Ide Masaru
source:
Sex: Male
Occupation: Prefectural Police Detective
Age: 35

An assistant inspector in the First Investigative Division of the Criminal Investigation Department of the Mie Prefectural Police. He often finds himself saddled with whatever troublesome tasks come to the department's way —something he makes sure to grumble about each time— but is a proficient detective in his own right, being diligent in his duties and having passed his promotion exam without difficulty.
Although often said to have a somewhat unreadable expression, he is quite sociable and makes a point to attend all the department drinking parties.
* * *
Born and raised in Mie, Masaru never ventured beyond bicycle commuting distance of his hometown, Tsu City, until the time came for him to attend university. With no particular plans for his future in mind, he took the employment exam for police officers, figuring that a local government job would at least be stable. He had no admiration for the police or any strong sense of duty or justice, but found the strict discipline of the police force suited his personality.
He quietly married a fellow classmate from the police academy soon after graduating, and at home he takes on the role of doting father to two sons and a daughter. If pressed to discuss his hobbies, they would include walking and combination puzzles. Strangely enough, he often happens to be walking nearby whenever incidents occur, leading to him being first on the scene even when off duty — something his colleagues frequently tease him about.

[From in-game profile]
